claim: Genre is the preset bundle — it seeds pace, lens, grade, music and sound across the whole film in one word. A director sets it so horror and sports stop needing forty hand-written tags to tell apart, and so every later variable has a sensible default to depart from.
method: identical subject sentence and seed in every panel; only the option clause changes. panels marked control render the untouched subject, because SDXL cannot express absence.

panels.clause: soft natural lighting, calm everyday atmosphere, gentle colors
dramatic lighting, serious expression, muted palette, restrained
romantic atmosphere, warm soft light, pink tones, soft focus
comedic, bright flat lighting, exaggerated expression
action, dynamic angle, motion blur, high contrast
suspense, low-key lighting, hard shadows, cold palette
horror, deep shadows, desaturated, sickly light
mystery, noir lighting, haze, muted colors
fantasy, magical glow, ethereal light, floating light motes
science fiction, holographic glow, neon accents, cyan light
mecha, mechanical parts, metallic sheen, industrial lighting
sports, sweat, intense determination, dynamic energy
isekai, otherworldly light, magic circle, fantasy sky
historical, period atmosphere, aged colors, warm lantern light
supernatural, ghostly mist, eerie glow, pale aura
documentary, candid, naturalistic flat lighting, observational

review.issue: documentary ("documentary, candid, naturalistic flat lighting, observational") and slice_of_life ("soft natural lighting, calm everyday atmosphere, gentle colors") both reduce to naturally lit boy, and "observational" / "calm everyday atmosphere" render nothing. Separately, sports ("sports, sweat, intense determination, dynamic energy") restates the subject sentence — the subject is already a jerseyed striker in a floodlit stadium — so that panel will be near-indistinguishable from the no-clause control.
review.fix: Give documentary a visible camera signature ("handheld framing, off-center composition, flat available light") and slice_of_life a light signature ("soft diffused light, pastel palette"). For sports, either drop the option as untestable against a soccer subject or cut it to the part the subject does not already supply: "sweat, motion blur, low angle".
